reviews.review:
If you are looking for a deep farming sim packed with systems, upgrades, and NPC relationships, this is not that kind of game.
But if what you want is a gentle little escape, Cottonville may be a surprisingly sweet way to unwind for sure!

You run your own tiny shop (sadly, you can not decorate it… I know, tragic fr), plant crops, unlock adorable clothing blueprints, and turn your harvest into outfits to sell. It is repetitive, and there is not a ton of content, but the concept is charming and the art style is lovely!

But yea, its not bad, but it is not perfect at all. I cant recommend it at full price, but on a good sale? it is a sweet little pastel-soft treat, and you really do not have to stress or think at all lol. 
Achievement-wise i am missing 3 of them, and they are a little grindy (normally i dont mind, but there is just not so much to do in the game after 3 hours ish, so it become a little boring)
